symptom_signature: COM status: 'Access denied to COMx' or IOException
likely_cause: Serial port already opened by another process (iCem, terminal, another iCemEmule)
probe: Get-Process | Where-Object {$_.ProcessName -match 'iCem|iCemEmule|PuTTY'}; then try port open
remediation: Close the other process or select a free COM port in EmulatorPage (COM tab) or ctl setport

likely_cause: ComPort string does not match an existing port
remediation: Select a valid port from the dropdown/list

symptom_signature: LAN status: 'Npcap not found. Install Npcap ...'
likely_cause: SharpPcap cannot load wpcap.dll (Npcap not installed or WinPcap API-compatible mode disabled)
remediation: Install Npcap with 'WinPcap API-compatible mode' checkbox selected; reboot if needed

symptom_signature: LAN status: 'Src MAC not set and adapter has no MAC'
likely_cause: No explicit src MAC and opened adapter reports no MAC address
probe: Get-NetAdapter -Name '*82574L*' | Select MacAddress; AceLanEmitter auto-detect falls back to adapter MAC
remediation: Adapter MAC auto-detect covers 82574L; else check adapter

symptom_signature: LAN status: 'SendPacket error ... access ... permission ... denied'
likely_cause: Raw socket packet injection requires Administrator privileges

symptom_signature: Manual value typed in EmulatorPage (LAN tab) does not reach wire, or oversized string signal edit is rejected
likely_cause: EmulatorPage/ctl may call SetOverride before CanTransmit; provider guard rejects edits where (ByteOffset-4)+Size>124
probe: iCemEmule.exe --selftest T5 checks Pump A Pressure FF edit, Side A Kicked Out HX edit, and UC-120 transmittable (oversize guard)
remediation: ctl set routes through CanTransmit; provider guard rejects overflow

symptom_signature: iCemEmule starts with streams enabled despite no explicit start command
likely_cause: emule_config.xml loaded with stale values; additive schema tolerated corrupt files
remediation: Edit or delete emule_config.xml (2026-08-31: moved from %LOCALAPPDATA% settings.xml; legacy file is copy-migrated on first load); missing file ⇒ defaults (ALL OFF); changes saved on ctl set* / Shutdown

id: embedded emulator region stays black/invisible although the UI process is alive (visible=False on the top window AND on DesktopChildSiteBridge)
symptom_signature: enumerate the child window: GetWindowLongPtr(GWL_STYLE) has WS_CHILD + GetParent == shell hwnd
likely_cause: SetParent-child reparent of a WinUI 3 AppWindow: the framework state machine treats the external reparent as hide and keeps its site bridge hidden — external reparent of a WinUI 3 window is NOT supported by AppWindow
probe: embed as OWNED OVERLAY instead (W12): keep the child window top-level frameless, set GWLP_HWNDPARENT=shell (z-order, hide-with-owner, no taskbar), position over the anchor in screen coords; HWND discovery via EnumWindows by PID+class (MainWindowHandle heuristic fails on frameless windows)

symptom_signature: EmulatorPage shows live PID but empty snapshot fields (uptime/template/vars lists stay empty); all ctl commands from the UI silently no-op
likely_cause: EmuPipeClient.Send set NamedPipeClientStream.ReadTimeout; CanTimeout=false for this stream in the WinUI app context => setter throws InvalidOperationException swallowed by the blanket catch => every command returned null
probe: #if DEBUG layout dump in EmulatorPage writes %TEMP%\emu_layout.txt: pipe status => NULL vs raw connect OK
remediation: Read timeout via CancellationToken on ReadAsync instead of ReadTimeout property (W13.3)

likely_cause: MainWindow.xaml strip uses MacSeparatorBrush — SHELL frozen ThemeResources copy (pre-W13.5) lacks the token; {ThemeResource} XamlParseException
probe: crash.log next to shell exe: Cannot find a Resource with the Name/Key MacSeparatorBrush
remediation: Use MacSurface2Brush in shell window XAML until frozen shell copy is synced (approved by owner)

symptom_signature: Dark caption renders system BLACK, text/bg color race
likely_cause: Win10 19045: AppWindow.TitleBar.*Color is Win11-only (DWMWA_CAPTION_COLOR); immersive dark = system black caption; framework resets immersive flag after Activated
probe: live DWM attr20 readback + screen pixel sample
remediation: Custom title bar: ExtendsContentIntoTitleBar + XAML strip on theme tokens + SetTitleBar; caption buttons colored via ApplyTitleBarTheme (race removed by construction)

symptom_signature: No rounded window corners on Win10
remediation: Platform limitation — attr call harmless (works on Win11), no Win10 workaround for XAML windows

likely_cause: Plain dotnet build writes bin\Debug (no platform); DeployEmuleEngine copies bin\x64\Debug
probe: Compare LastWriteTime of source vs deployed exe
remediation: Always build UI projects with -p:Platform=x64 (W5 recurrence)

symptom_signature: Title bar hamburger does not highlight on hover in light theme
likely_cause: Stock ButtonBackgroundPointerOver (ControlFillColorSecondary light ~= #F9F9F9) is LIGHTER than strip #F5F5F7 => invisible; intermediate MacSurface2 fix was visible but owner directed to replicate left-pane code
probe: hover hamburger in light theme; sample strip vs button pixel delta
remediation: Use stock PaneToggleButtonStyle (same style as NavigationView TogglePaneButton, generic.xaml L15140): hover/pressed = SubtleFillColorSecondary/Tertiary (#09000000/#06000000 light, #0FFFFFFF/#0AFFFFFF dark) — darker than strip in light theme

symptom_signature: PrintWindow screenshot of static title bar misses button fill/glyph (all strip color)
likely_cause: PrintWindow(PW_RENDERFULLCONTENT) returns stale composition surface for STATIC content; live-updating pages (charts) keep surface dirty so captures look fine
probe: compare PrintWindow capture vs CopyFromScreen of the same window
remediation: Use CopyFromScreen (BitBlt) for pixel proofs of static surfaces; note GetWindowRect includes +8px invisible resize border

likely_cause: ThemeDictionaries property exposes ONLY dictionaries declared directly on the app-level ResourceDictionary; merged/source'd dicts (XamlControlsResources, ThemeResources.xaml) are not visible
probe: enumerate ThemeDictionaries keys at ctor and after Loaded
remediation: Probe actual resolved brushes via template root (root.Background) after GoToState, not via ThemeDictionaries enumeration

symptom_signature: LAN card shows «SV: —» while the engine is alive (svCount never displayed)
likely_cause: EmulatorViewModel.cs:423 reads lan.svCount via Str(), which requires JsonValueKind.String; the engine emits svCount as a NUMBER (EmuEngineHost.GetStatus → _overrideProvider.ActiveSvNumbers.Count)
probe: iCemEmule.exe --ctl status ⇒ data.lan.svCount is a bare number; EmulatorPage.xaml.cs:492 renders «SV: —»
remediation: Fix EmulatorViewModel.cs:423 — read svCount via Num() (same helper as framesSent/linesSent) or accept Number in Str(); until fixed the UI shows «SV: —»
